messages:
Sarah L.: Posting follow-ups from the 2026-03-20 P99 latency incident. Need owners, Jira links, RACI, and handoffs. Summary + proposed assignments below. Please ack and update by EOD Fri.

Sarah L.: ```
1) INFR-3421 - KV cache eviction on 8k contexts -> Owner: Rajesh K. - Due: 2026-04-02 - R: Rajesh, A: Tom B., C: Megan C., I: Eng SRE
2) PM-890 - Canary config mismatch -> Owner: Olivia P. - Due: 2026-03-30 - R: Olivia, A: Sarah L., C: DevEx, I: All
3) INFR-3456 - Long-tail batching fallback -> Owner: Tom B. - Due: 2026-04-09 - R: Tom, A: Rajesh, C: ML Eng, I: Console Team
4) PM-901 - KV evictions epic (recurring incidents) -> Owner: Megan C. - Due: 2026-04-16 - R: Megan, A: Sarah L., C: SRE/ML, I: Product
```

Rajesh K.: Ack. I'll create INFR-3421 subtask for the evictor test and attach perf logs. ETA for initial PR by 2026-03-29.

Tom B.: I can own INFR-3456. Quick Q: do we want quantization changes in scope? I'd prefer spike-first so we don't mix rollout risk.

Megan C.: Noted recurring pattern: we've hit similar KV cache evictions twice in the last quarter (see INFR-3000, INFR-3182). I think PM-901 should be an epic to capture RCA + mitigations. @Sarah L. can we make that a separate epic? :eyes: 

Olivia P.: Link to canary ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PM-890 I'll add acceptance criteria and link runbook updates. Handoff to infra on 2026-03-25.

Sarah L.: Yes Megan, please create PM-901 'kv-evictions-epic' and assign me as A until we decide prioritization. @Megan C. please draft SLO/regression test proposals and put first draft in the epic by 2026-04-02.

Tom B.: Spike ticket created: INFR-3460. PRs will reference it. cc @Rajesh K.

incidents-bot: Incident 2026-03-20-PL99 closed. Postmortem published: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-20-p99-latency

Megan C.: I'll take PM-901 for the RCA epic writeup. Setting up sync with SRE/ML next Tue. Can someone add me to the infra calendar and the recurring 'postmortem check' rotation?

Sarah L.: Added calendar invite. Also assigning weekly check-in ownership rotation: week of 2026-03-29 -> Rajesh K., week of 2026-04-05 -> Tom B. We'll run short 30m standups to surface blockers.

Tom B.: Confirming 30m standups. Also pinging DevEx for reproducibility instructions. @DevEx can you share a dev container + run instructions?

DevEx: I'll post a quickrun doc and a dev container link by EOD tomorrow (will attach to each linked Jira ticket).

Megan C.: :white_check_mark: all set. I'll open the epic, add recurring incident analysis, and include a timeline of previous evictions plus a proposed regression test harness.

Sarah L.: Final ask: owners, please link your Jira to the postmortem page and add 'blocked-by' if infrastructure limits are required. Also mark status in the postmortem doc as 'in-progress' once you create the ticket. Thanks.

Olivia P.: Acked and updated PM-890 with runbook and handoff notes.

Tom B.: One more note — if batching fallback is a quick win we should hotfix before epic work. I'll surface in the first standup.

Rajesh K.: Will include perf counter dumps and an initial mitigation proposal in INFR-3421 by 2026-03-29.

Megan C.: Scheduling the RCA sync (SRE+ML+Infra) for Tue 2026-03-23 10:30a PT. Invite sent.

Sarah L.: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after the first week of updates and decide if PM-901 needs higher priority.
